channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Brandon is applying for a grant to plan housing and transportation projects. The Better Connections grant will fund community engagement and planning for future developments. The town will provide a ten percent match from economic development funds.
Rutland City voters approved a capital reserve fund for public schools. The fund will support building and equipment improvements. It will not impact local taxes.

The Otter Valley School Board is facing budget challenges for fiscal year twenty-twenty-eight. They approved a retirement buyout program for eligible teachers and administrators. The board will discuss bus stop clustering and preschool programs at their next meeting on November seventeenth.

Voters in Essex, Bennington and Hinesburg mostly rejected local option taxes on meals and retail sales. Essex approved a one percent rooms tax but must vote again due to a procedural error. Bennington’s rejection means losing an estimated one point eight million dollars in revenue.
